title: Code quality (Jev)
description: Proposes distinct files for contextual review using a fixed Jev-wire checklist, through TypeSafe or the operator's local endpoint. Bounded code and code/comment windows produce attributed allegations, explicit uncertainty and coverage gaps. Correctness and maintainability lanes are separate from legacy scores; unflagged files are not certified safe. Scans retain partial evidence and resume under a pinned model.

settings.title: Judge
settings.description: where the texts are judged: TypeSafe's hosted Jev, or a judge you run on your own network that speaks Jev's wire

labels.local: A judge on your own network

settings.title: Jev API key
settings.description: TypeSafe's Jev key, for the hosted judge: paste it here; it is kept by AII OS and rides only to api.typesafe.ai. A local judge is sent no key

settings.title: Local judge address
settings.description: for the local judge: its base address, http://<host>:<port>, under which it answers /v1/systemone and /v1/models; grant that address to this plugin as a local network address

settings.title: Model
settings.description: the model every request names; the list comes from the judge

settings.title: Time per step, ms
settings.description: the most a step waits on the judge in all; keep it inside the host's limit on one call

settings.title: Time per call, ms
settings.description: the most one judge call may take; a step's calls share its time and never get more than this

settings.title: Judge calls per step
settings.description: the judge calls one step or one judge request makes at most

settings.title: Calls in a retry step
settings.description: the calls a step makes after one that found the judge unavailable, each given longer

settings.title: Chunk size, bytes
settings.description: the most source text sent in one call; lower it for a judge with a smaller input limit. A scan keeps the size it started with

settings.title: File size cap, bytes
settings.description: Maximum raw source file bytes; larger files remain visible as coverage gaps. Requests use bounded contextual windows.

settings.title: Scans kept
settings.description: how many of the most recent scans are kept; starting one more removes the oldest

settings.title: Answer cache, bytes
settings.description: the most the answer cache keeps, in sixteen files; past its share a file keeps its newest answers

settings.title: Scans advance by themselves
settings.description: the host steps an unfinished scan every ten minutes, so it needs no call for every step; off, each step is a call
